title: Derived global sections of a derived direct image
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. For every open subscheme $U\subseteq Y$, with $f_U:f^{-1}U\to U$, there is a natural isomorphism $R\Gamma(U,R(f_U)_*(E|_{f^{-1}U}))\cong R\Gamma(f^{-1}U,E|_{f^{-1}U})$ of complexes of abelian groups; $R(f_U)_*$ is the derived direct image [def-pc-derived-direct-image] and $R\Gamma$ is the derived global-sections functor [def-sc-sheaf-cohomology-functor].
